heroHeadline: Reuters Exclusive: China Covertly Trained ~200 Russian Soldiers in Drone Warfare — Now Fighting in Ukraine; Russia Fires 209 More Drones Overnight as Belarus-Russia Nuclear Drills Escalate
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,545 of Russia's full-scale invasion, a Reuters exclusive based on three European intelligence agencies revealed China's PLA secretly trained approximately 200 Russian military personnel at facilities in Shijiazhuang and Zhengzhou in late 2025, focusing on drone warfare and counter-drone air defense tactics; those soldiers have since returned to fight in Ukraine. The program, authorized by a dual-language agreement signed July 2, 2025, directly contradicts China's public neutrality claim. Overnight May 18–19, Russia launched another 209 Shahed-type drones at Ukraine, with 180 intercepted; Kharkiv's Novobavarskyi district had 25 buildings damaged and Odesa Oblast's Izmail district recorded a warehouse strike. Belarus and Russia simultaneously launched joint tactical nuclear weapons exercises involving nuclear-capable aircraft and missile units, which Ukraine's Foreign Ministry condemned as 'an unprecedented challenge to the global security architecture.' A Reuters/US News analysis confirmed Ukraine's mid-range strike campaign has doubled since March 2026, with 129 Russian air defense systems destroyed year-to-date; Ukrainian Chaklun-V UAVs struck the Smolensk Aviation Plant. Russian cumulative military losses reached an estimated 1,351,150 personnel since February 24, 2022 (+1,140 on May 19).
